entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker artificer who runs the Tolarian academy to build time machines and weapons against the Phyrexians and is eventually humbled by Multani and Serra's Realm.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem given Xantcha's heart who develops emotions, befriends Jhoira and becomes Master of Engines on the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: An artificer from Shiv, Karn's friend, who survives the Tolaria explosion and becomes captain of the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: An immature Zhalfirin mage who harasses Karn and is later trapped in a pocket of slow time.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Mage master of the Tolarian academy who knows its true purpose and defends it.

entities.name: Kerrick
entities.description: A shipwrecked man who is really a Phyrexian infiltrator, who calls Negators and later grows them in the fast-time chasm.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: A being whose heart powers Karn, mentioned as having visited Serra's Realm with Urza.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: The remote island where Urza's academy stands.

entities.name: Tolarian academy
entities.description: Urza's academy of artificers and mages preparing for the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders whose Negators attack Tolaria and Serra's Realm.

entities.name: Negators
entities.description: Phyrexian soldiers that massacre the Tolarian students and teachers.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: The avatar of Yavimaya who imprisons Urza for the harm to Argoth, then lends him strength against K’rrik.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: The forest where Urza seeks special wood and is imprisoned by Multani.

entities.name: Titania
entities.description: The spirit of Argoth devastated in the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: Home of a Thran Mana Rig, where Urza makes peace among Viashino, goblins and fire dragons.

entities.name: Gherridarigaaz
entities.description: A fire dragon Urza employs and who is killed by Radiant.

entities.name: Rhammidarigaaz
entities.description: A fire dragon ridden by Barrin.

entities.name: Serra's Realm
entities.description: Serra's abandoned plane under siege from Phyrexia, which collapses.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: The planeswalker who abandoned her realm.

entities.name: Radiant
entities.description: An archangel leading Serra's Realm's forces, who declares Urza a Phyrexian and is destroyed rejoining his powerstone eyes.

entities.name: Gorig
entities.description: Radiant's sleeper Phyrexian war minister who is the mana battery.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Urza's flying skyship that can planeswalk, christened with Jhoira as captain and Karn as Master of Engines.

entities.name: Thran Mana Rig
entities.description: A massive inactive Thran machine in Shiv that Urza puts to work.

entities.name: Tolarian Temporal Disaster
entities.description: The temporal explosion that levels the Tolarian academy.

entities.name: Collapse of Serra's Realm
entities.description: The final implosion of Serra's Realm.

events.summary: Urza gives a silver golem Xantcha's heart; named Karn, it learns emotions and befriends Jhoira while Teferi harasses it.
events.quote: taking the name Karn from the Thran word for mighty

events.summary: Jhoira hides the shipwrecked Kerrick; Karn sees him steal powerstones and call for Negators, who massacre the students and teachers including Jhoira, Teferi and Barrin.
events.quote: The Phyrexian Negators massacred most of the students and teachers including Jhoira, Teferi, and Barrin.

events.summary: Karn travels back to stop Kerrick, but the temporal surge causes an explosion that levels the academy; Urza planeswalks fourteen people to safety and Karn leads thirty survivors out.
events.quote: cause a huge explosion that levels the academy

events.summary: Ten years later Urza and Barrin return to Tolaria, where time rifts nearly kill them until Jhoira, who survived, saves them and shows them the fast-time chasm holding Kerrick and the Phyrexians.
events.quote: Urza realizes that Kerrick and the surviving Phyrexians are stuck inside.

events.summary: Urza's dirigible attack on the chasm fails and Jhoira falls into a coma; she later builds a machine to funnel fast time into slow-time areas, saving Teferi.
events.quote: Jhoira falls into a coma for several years

events.summary: Urza's falcon attack fails and he is captured and disemboweled by K’rrik until Karn rescues him.
events.quote: Karn sees Urza fall into the chasm and rushes into it

events.summary: Urza travels to Shiv, makes peace among the Viashino, goblins and dragons and puts them to work on the Thran Mana Rig.
events.quote: He makes peace between the local Viashino , Goblins , and fire dragons

events.summary: In Yavimaya Multani, remembering Argoth's devastation, ensorcells Urza in a tree for three years.
events.quote: Urza apologizes but is ensorcelled by Multani until he is encased in a tree

events.summary: Barrin's beacon wakes Urza; Multani sees Urza protecting life, and the two kill K’rrik and destroy the Negators.
events.quote: Multani animates Tolaria's forests and the remaining negators are destroyed.

events.summary: Urza visits Serra's Realm and meets Radiant, who reprimands him, lets him watch her purification armies, then refuses to let him take refugees and declares him a Phyrexian.
events.quote: Radiant refuses and declares him a Phyrexian

events.summary: Urza evacuates refugees and learns Radiant's soul torches are siphoning the plane's white mana through her sleeper Gorig.
events.quote: Urza repeatedly returns to Serra's Realm to evacuate hundreds of refugees to Dominaria

events.summary: Urza completes the skyship and christens it the Weatherlight, naming Karn Master of Engines and Jhoira Captain.
events.quote: Urza christens it the Weatherlight and names Karn the Master of Engines and Jhoira the Captain.

events.summary: At Serra's Realm Barrin tricks Gorig into impaling itself on the Weatherlight, charging the powerstone, while Radiant kills Gherridarigaaz and rips out Urza's powerstone eyes.
events.quote: Radiant challenges Urza to single combat and kills Gherridarigaaz.

events.summary: Radiant tries to rejoin the powerstones, causing an explosion that destroys her and reconstitutes Urza; the crew escapes as Serra's Realm collapses.
events.quote: causing an explosion that destroys her and reconstitutes Urza

events.summary: Months later Jhoira commands the Weatherlight, Teferi works to end Zhalfir's civil war, and Barrin reflects that Urza is finally sane.
events.quote: Barrin reflects that Urza is now finally sane.
